summary: Zatch Bell! (150 eps) adapts Konjiki no Gash!! chapters 1-211 of 323 and then invents its own ending. The three seasons are clean chapter blocks - S1 (eps 1-50) = ch 1-99, S2 (eps 51-100) = ch 100-163, S3 (eps 101-150) = ch 164-211 - and en.wikipedia's chapter list, the zatchbell.fandom chapter pages and the context file's volume table all agree on the same 323-chapter space, so no conversion is needed. The big structural finding is that SEASON 1 IS HEAVILY RESEQUENCED: ep 12 jumps to ch 54-55 (Sherry/Koko), eps 14-16 backfill 35-38 then 29-31, ep 17 picks up the skipped ch 21, ep 18 pulls ch 52-53 forward, ep 23 pulls a cold open off ch 83, ep 26 backfills 32-33, ep 36 backfills the skipped ch 63, ep 39 jumps to 80-82 before eps 42-43 return to 75-79, and ep 47 jumps to ch 99 before eps 48-50 return to 83-84 and 95-98 - so linear interpolation across eps 10-50 is simply wrong and the per-episode anchors are load-bearing. Season 3 resequences once more: it opens on the Ted arc (ch 169-172, eps 101-102), plays ch 168 at ep 104, then backfills the Koral Q arc (ch 164-167, eps 105-107). Season 2 (eps 58-88) is the one long linear stretch. Chapters 34, 58 and 163 are never animated inside the canon run (34 and 163 surface only in AFL-filler eps 90 and 99). Ep 138 is the last adapted episode: ch 209-211, reader resumes at ch 212 - which resolves open flag #942 (the MU frontier pinned ch 212 on filler ep 139; the honest terminal is ep 138). The prior agent's open ep-123/ch-191 question is settled: ch 191 "Bari's Rival" is Keith introducing himself as Bari's archrival during the Faudo assault (ep 127), not ep 123's anime-original Bari vs Ted duel.

annotations.note: Ch 21 "The Curry of Friendship" is skipped when ep 10 animates 22-25 and is finally animated as the first half of ep 17.
Ep 12 jumps ~26 chapters ahead for the Sherry/Koko backstory (ch 54 "An Irreplaceable Friend", ch 55 "The Dark Tunnel"); the run returns to ch 29 at ep 16.
Ep 18 opens on ch 40 then pulls ch 52-53 (the Folgore-in-London reunion) forward; eps 19-22 then run 40-51 in order, so ep 18 END (53) is ahead of ep 22 END (51).

Ep 23's cold open (Seitaro handing Kiyo the first 1,000-year stone tablet) is lifted out of ch 83 "An Unidentified Object"; ch 83 is properly adapted at ep 48. The wiki infobox lists 83 under ep 23, but END in running order is ch 57.
Ep 26 backfills ch 32-33 (Nana Baba) skipped at ep 11-12; ep 36 backfills ch 63 "The Battle in the Park" skipped at ep 27.
Ep 39 animates ch 80-82 (Baransha the hunter) before eps 42-43 go back for ch 75-79.

Ep 47 animates ch 99 "The King's Appearance" (Brago/Sherry snowfield) out of order; eps 48-50 then run 83-84 and 95-98. Ch 99 is therefore the highest chapter season 1 reaches, matching AFG's "season 1 adapted manga 1 to 99".

Ch 34 is skipped when ep 14 animates 35-36. The zatchbell wiki places it in AFL-filler ep 90 ("The Hurricane Test Battle!"); A1 forbids an anchor there, so ch 34 is recorded as a permanent hole in the canon run.
Ch 58 is never animated: ep 23 ends at ch 57 and ep 24 starts at ch 59.
Ep 28 "Tia and Megumi's Excellent Adventure" adapts the volume 8 bonus side story (Princess Marie), not a mainline chapter - no mainline END exists, so no anchor.

Eps 66-68 cover ch 124-127 (bounded by ep 65 = ch 123 and ep 69 = ch 128) but no source gives the per-episode split, and the title evidence is contradictory: ch 128 "A Single Path" is clearly ep 69's magma stairway and ch 126 "Fighting Together" fits ep 67, yet ch 124 "Conversations of the Heart" reads like ep 68's wordless Tia/Zatch thank-you. Left unanchored rather than guessed; interpolation between eps 65 and 69 lands within one chapter.
Eps 85-86 share ch 158-159 and ep 87 starts at 160, so ep 86 is anime expansion inside the same material; no separate anchor.
AFL-filler ep 92 "Dr. Riddles' Renewed Vow" adapts the volume 17 bonus side story per the wiki infobox. A1: no anchor on a filler row; recorded as a fact only.

Ch 163 "We're Home" is the only chapter of volume 18 animated in season 2, and the wiki places it in AFL-filler ep 99 "Miss Wriggle's Class is Now in Session". AFG's own text ("season 2 adapted from manga 100 to 163") requires it to land somewhere in eps 89-100. A1 forbids the anchor; a reader stopping at ep 88 resumes at ch 163.

Season 3 opens OUT OF ORDER: eps 101-102 animate the Ted arc (ch 169-172), ep 104 animates ch 168 "Find the Gift!", and eps 105-107 then backfill the Koral Q arc (ch 164-167). Interpolating across eps 101-107 in chapter order is wrong.

Eps 139-150 are an anime-original ending (AFL, AFG): the anime stops adapting at ch 211 and never covers ch 212-323 (Faudo conclusion, Gorm/Mir arc, Clear Note arc). AFG: "start reading from chapter 212".

type_corrections.note: CONTESTED - Sean's call. Our rows follow AFL, which types every one of these Manga Canon. The zatchbell wiki types all ten anime-original in TWO independent places (each episode's infobox reads chaps=N/A or Filler, and the Story Arcs manga-vs-anime table lists them under "Season 1/2/3 Filler and Bonus"). Independent corroboration: exhaustive chapter accounting. Working purely from en.wikipedia's chapter list plus en.wikipedia's episode summaries, every chapter from 1 to 211 except 34, 58, 163 and 124-127 is already claimed by another episode - these ten have nothing left to adapt. Content check agrees: ep 13 Hyde rematch/silo hostages, ep 51 Milordo-Z's party invitation, ep 57 Brago on the sands, ep 103 Ted's blues, ep 108 a declared parody of 3000 Leagues in Search of Mother, ep 117 the Wonrei/Li-en street-fight, ep 118 Dartagnan's cruise, ep 119 a flashback recap of the already-animated ch 34-38 Tia origin, ep 122 the Princess Kaguya night, ep 123 the Bari vs Ted duel. Under A1 none of them carries an anchor either way, so the correction is about honest typing, not about position.

structure.notes: One AniList component (id 250), 150 episodes, and the zatchbell wiki numbers episodes cumulatively 1-150 exactly as our rows do - verified against all 150 episode pages, no duplicates and no gaps, so no numbering conversion was needed. Chapter space: 323 chapters / 33 volumes; en.wikipedia's chapter list reproduces the context file's volume table boundary-for-boundary (v1 1-8 ... v33 314-323) and 307 of the 316 fandom chapter pages carry the identical English title at the identical number, so fandom numbering = enwiki numbering = our chapter space. Season blocks (AFG, corroborated by the anchors): S1 eps 1-50 = ch 1-99, S2 eps 51-100 = ch 100-163, S3 eps 101-150 = ch 164-211. AFL filler blocks: 31-35, 89-100, 139-150. The anime's last adapted episode is 138 (ch 209-211) and the reader's resume is ch 212 (volume 22) - eps 139-150 are an original ending. Order-only extras are NOT in our rows; AFG places them at: OVA 1 (00F ~Ogon no Chichi wo Motsu Otoko~) after ep 50, Movie 1 (Unlisted Demon No. 101) after ep 67, OVA 2 (Hashire Gash!! Ubawareta Umagon) after ep 94, Movie 2 (Attack of the Mechavulcan) after ep 117. Two English-only clip specials also exist (after eps 26 and 52 in content terms).

flags_for_sean: RESOLVES open flag #942: the MU frontier pinned ch 212 on filler ep 139. The honest terminal is ep 138 -> END ch 211, continue ch 212 - stated outright by AFG ("the last episode that was adapted from the manga was the 138, which corresponds to Chapters 209, 210 and 211" / "start reading from Chapter 212") and corroborated by chapter titles (209 "The Resurrection of Faudo", 211 "The Brain Strategy" = the episode's "Kiyomaro's secret plan").

SETTLED (prior agent's open question): ep 123 / ch 191. Ch 191 "Bari's Rival" belongs to ep 127, not ep 123. en.wikipedia's ep 127 summary says explicitly "with Keith prating about being Bari's archrival in the Mamodo world", which is what the chapter title names; ep 123's Bari vs Ted duel has no chapter behind it and the zatchbell wiki lists ep 123 under Season 3 Filler and Bonus.

TYPE DISAGREEMENT (needs a ruling): eps 13, 51, 57, 103, 108, 117, 118, 119, 122, 123 are Manga Canon in AFL (our row source) but anime-original in the zatchbell wiki in two places, and exhaustive chapter accounting leaves them with nothing to adapt. See type_corrections. Under A1 they carry no anchors either way.

A1 WITHHELD ANCHORS (filler rows that do adapt manga): ep 90 -> ch 34, ep 92 -> volume 17 bonus side story, ep 99 -> ch 163. Each is a whole chapter, not a <=5-page sliver, so the sliver ruling does not obviously cover them; if any of these rows should be re-typed mixed they would become anchorable. Recorded as annotations only for now.

UNRESOLVED SPLIT: eps 66-68 cover ch 124-127 with no per-episode split available from any source (see annotation). Eps 65 and 69 are anchored either side, so interpolation error is at most one chapter.

SOFT SPLIT: the Momon arc is bounded ch 184-187 <-> eps 120-121 by the wiki's Story Arcs table, but the internal split is my even-split derivation (120 = 184-185, 121 = 186-187), both marked medium. Ch 187 "Kiyo's Mood" could instead be ep 123's or ep 124's Kiyo scene; ep 124 is left unanchored for that reason.

SOFT SPLIT: eps 125-129 cover ch 188-194 and eps 134-137 cover ch 203-208; the fixed points (ep 130 = 195-196 and ep 133 = 201-202 from the wiki infobox, ep 138 = 209-211 from AFG) are firm, but the 1-vs-2 chapter distribution inside those two runs is derived from chapter-title-to-summary matching. Eps 129, 134, 135 are marked medium for that reason.

ep 102: the wiki infobox credits ch 167 to BOTH ep 102 and ep 107. I took 171-172 as ep 102's body (END 172) and left 167 with ep 107, since ch 167 "Something Impossible" is the Koral Q finish. Marked medium.
